notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
1. Added mouse invert-Y option
2. Clarified game instructions (in the form of an opening message from Prof Xenoba) that all players should read
3. Range of player walking speeds has been increased (but we still recommend taking it slowly, you know, to smell the roses)
4. Fixed problem with leaving the PlantGen station

notes.title: Be careful jumping
notes.notes: One or two players have reported jumping off the space ship, and effectively falling through space forever. Currently, the only thing to do if this happens is to start a new game. Until we get the problem with wall/ceiling colliders fixed, be careful with your jumps.

notes.title: Solarium offers plant-centric edutainment!
notes.notes:
I downloaded free game Solarium [official site] pretty much entirely on the strength of the following negative Steam review: “I didn’t play it very long, but it’s literally all about plants. I guess I should’ve read more reviews about it prior to downloading, but unless you’re really interested in learning about plants, I wouldn’t suggest playing.”

Literally all about plants! Learning about plants!

What I found was a kind of Encarta ’95 Mind Maze-ish style of game as a kind of odd fusion of slightly stilted graphics and educational information. (more…)
